title: Exact range scorer: range size and coupled worker sweep
question: Can range size and coupled score/merge worker counts improve exact complete-query latency while controlling tracked allocation?
hypothesis: Smaller work ranges with matched worker count may reduce complete-query latency; metadata and final merge overhead may cancel that gain.
motivation: Improve exact retrieval speed while reporting complete tracked resource cost, building on the integrated V2 scorer.

declared_changes.runtime: Accurately mark guarded uint32 arithmetic and report resolved metadata; no scoring kernel or timed-loop change.
declared_changes.measurement: Real external runtime gate replaces historical parent stand-in; fresh correctness/complete memory accounting and calibration confirmation.

input_manifest.per_run: Resolve actual encoded index/build/settings before each real runner release; preserve manifests under results/<experiment-id>/<run-id>.

query_split: 500 calibration queries only; no held-out queries.
timing_boundary: Host query construction, kernel-argument query transfer, complete scoring/local selection/last-block merge, result D2H and synchronization.

correctness_rule.parent_fixture_cases: All nine inherited cases plus a new odd-score-above2^24/full-uint64-ID case, all nine matrix cells, k10 and VERIFY1; independent Python rankings and three full query rounds.
correctness_rule.empty_queries: Inherited fixture empty/zero/unknown-term queries remain intact.
correctness_rule.additional_depths: k0,1,128 on ties fixture in all nine cells; k1000 on smallest-worker/smallest-range and control as stress-only, not measured performance.
correctness_rule.real: All500 calibration queries, one correctness round per cell, outputs checked against the unchanged hash-bound CPU oracle and returned-score replay. No CPU verification inside timed query measurements.
correctness_rule.runtime: Host default and bounded acceptance tests plus intentional scalar mismatch; first CUDA wrong score_threads expectation must reject before query outputs.

measurement_and_analysis_plan.order: Natural/magic-square/reverse orders balance the average timing-slot position of every range-size and thread-count factor. Individual cell comparisons remain conditional on three processes and shared-node variation.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.primary: Geometric mean of paired query/process ratios of20-round medians to same-session W1024/T256 control;10000 crossed process/query bootstrap draws,seed20261115.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.descriptive: Pooled median,mean and p95 of1500query/process medians;not serving-tail percentile.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.boundary: Host query construction, kernel-argument query transfer, complete scoring/local selection/last-block merge, result D2H and synchronization.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.excluded: Index build/load/verification/rank construction/upload; runtime gate; file I/O and independent CPU validation.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.selection: Eligible candidates require point ratio<=0.98 and conditional95%upper bound<1. Among eligible cells choose minimum point ratio; eligible estimates within2% are tied, prefer lower full tracked allocation, then deterministic label. If none qualify, retain control. Report every cell and memory/Pareto tradeoff; selection intervals are not confirmatory.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.confirmation: If a noncontrol candidate qualifies, freeze it against control in a fresh calibration session:3processes each,3warmup/20measured rounds, fixed AB/BA/AB order, bootstrap seed20261117. Promote as latency winner only if confirmation95%upper ratio<0.98; otherwise retaincontrol. Confirmation is repeated calibration, not held-out evaluation.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.contention: Observe target UUID before each process; wait in10minute availability cycles while occupied. One passive observer and per-timing sampler; sampled absence of contention is not exclusivity.
measurement_and_analysis_plan.stopping: Stop on technical failure and preserve evidence; separate reviewed repairs<=3. Complete fixed matrix even if slower; no outcome-driven retuning.

contention_policy.rule: Retain every run. A sampled second target-GPU compute context makes that timing process ineligible; retry after idle with a fresh registered tag, at most three replacements. Never reject based on latency. Missing monitor evidence or persistent contention stops the protocol. Absence of sampled contention is not proof of exclusivity.

success_rule: All exactness/runtime/accounting checks pass; fresh confirmation upper95 ratio<0.98 for promotion.
failure_rule: Stop on technical/semantic failure; inspect and separately review each repair, at most3; preserve every attempt.
next_if_negative: Retain control; use measured latency/resource tradeoffs to select follow-on optimization.
